remarks: Set within a well-kept community just off the Post Road, this townhouse condo offers space, flexibility, and everyday ease in a layout that lives more like a single-family home. The entry level features a two-car garage with additional storage, while the main living level features hardwood floors throughout, a comfortable living room anchored by a gas fireplace, and a dining area with sliders to a balcony. The oversized kitchen is designed for real use, complete with an island, ample cabinetry, and smart energy-efficient appliances, plus a convenient half bath on this floor. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a walk-in closet and a spacious bath with double vanity, stall shower, and hydro tub, alongside a second bedroom, full bath with tub and shower, and an in-unit laundry closet. The top level adds even more versatility with a third bedroom, office, or studio space, a full bath, and storage tucked into the eaves. Outside, enjoy a grassy area in front of the unit and a shared green space between buildings that's perfect for pets or casual outdoor time. The location puts you within minutes of the SONO Train Station, Mall, Restaurants and Grocery Stores. Take a closer look and see how this thoughtfully designed home continues to deliver more space and flexibility than you might expect.
